item.title: RimWorld Best Traits — Tier List Ranked (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Here's our RimWorld best traits tier list for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Use it to pick strong starting colonists and build efficient roles. Tier S — Always Take These TraitEffect Sanguine+10 mood always — free stability IndustriousGlobal work speed +30% Too SmartResearch +40%, learning +70% Tier A — Great for Specific Roles TraitBest role ToughFrontline fighter (damage -50%) BrawlerMelee specialist JoggerHauler / scout (speed +25%) Quick SleeperAny long worker Night OwlNight-shift pawns Tier B — Situational Greedy, Jealous and Abrasive have real downsides but can be managed with good bedrooms and scheduling.
